name: Lust
overview: Scripture reveals lust as a sinful desire that leads to serious moral failure, as seen in Genesis 3:6 where the woman was drawn by the pleasantness and desirability of the forbidden fruit. The commandment in Exodus 20:17 forbids coveting a neighbor's wife, highlighting lust as a violation of God's design for relationships. Job's commitment to purity, expressed in Job 31:1 and his condemnation of adultery in verses 9-11, underscores the gravity of lust and sexual immorality as heinous crimes deserving of judgment. Together, these verses teach that lust is an evil desire that corrupts the heart and disrupts the sanctity of marriage.
